scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild js/provider.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --loader:.wasm=dataurl --sourcemap --outfile=dist/provider.js
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
